information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTczODc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--02e6d29a61b0dd2745ee55791e80dd6dccf8b9cd/image.png) ### **Welcome to the first ever Philippine FMC Championship.** This competition will determine the **2026 Philippine National Champion** for **3x3 Fewest Moves**. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look at [Philippine Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineChampionship2026). --- ### Locations See [Location tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineFMCChampionship2026#73905-locations) for more details. --- *Additional locations may be added until 14 days before the competition starts, so stay tuned for updates!*
